hooks.name: Spec drift check
hooks.description: After each task, diff the code against the spec and report drift instead of letting it accumulate.

action.prompt: A spec task just finished. Read .kiro/specs/switchpoint/design.md and requirements.md, then the code you changed. Report every place the code drifted from the spec: missing requirements, changed formulas, numbers that do not trace to .kiro/steering/mass-save-rules.md, and any new feature that is not a row in tasks.md. Output a short list of gaps, largest first. Do not change code in this run.
